question: What is the correct percentage by volume of various gases in Earth's atmosphere?

options.text: 20.95% nitrogen, 78.09% oxygen, and 0.04% carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
10.95% nitrogen, 88.09% oxygen, and 0.09% carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
10.95% nitrogen, 78.09% oxygen, and 0.03% carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, and 0.03% carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.

solution: The correct answer is __**78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, and 0.03% carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Composition of the atmosphere: • The air we take in while breathing is actually a mixture of many gases. • Nitrogen and oxygen are two gases that make up the bulk of the atmosphere. • Carbon dioxide, helium, ozone, argon, and hydrogen are found in lesser quantities. • Apart from these gases, tiny dust particles are also present in the air. • These dust particles present in the air are commonly referred to as aerosols.
